relations: Hands lifting and spreading near the knees triggers the torso to rise from the deep forward lean.
As the torso straightens, the legs extend and the front foot reaches forward on a pointed toe.
The mirror reflection synchronizes with the rising torso and extending limbs throughout the sequence.
caption: The video captures a single female dancer with a high ponytail, in a sheer black long-sleeve top, short black skirt with thin belt, and black boots, standing in right-facing profile beside a full-height mirror in a bright white studio with a light wood floor. She holds a deep forward torso lean, knees bent and arms hanging near knee level, a posture already sustained when the excerpt opens. Her hands then lift and spread, fingers splayed, drawing together in front of her lower body while the lean persists. As the hands pull back toward her hips, her torso gradually rises out of the forward bend. With the body nearly upright, both arms extend forward horizontally, palms meeting in front of her. The arms continue their sweep upward into a diagonal overhead extension, hands climbing above head level. Her legs straighten from the squat as the front foot reaches forward on a pointed toe while the back foot stays planted. The mirror reproduces every phase of this motion in sync, confirming the second figure is her reflection. The ceiling track lights, white curtain, and wall-mounted air conditioner remain fixed behind her.
